This file carries part 4 of 5 of the array — rows 174280–233516 of 292287 in rubric order; the 5 parts in file order are the full array. Rows omit a field whose value is the default: panelState defaults to “not a panel question.”, panelMember to false, owningFragmentId to null and moneyWeight to “standard”; non-default values are carried verbatim.
